fiscal.title: Automated Algerian Tax Calendar & Declarations
fiscal.desc: Eliminate the fear of late tax penalties. TAYSIR COMPTA automatically tracks and schedules all your statutory deadlines: monthly G50 (VAT & salary IRG), the 3 IBS installments, annual G4 tax packages, and IFU G12 / G12 Bis declarations.
bullets: Full support for both RÉEL and FORFAITAIRE (IFU) tax regimes
Proactive notifications and real-time status tracking
Seamless synchronization between the business and its accounting firm

bank.title: Smart Bank Reconciliation & Certified Audit

how_section.title: How Does TAYSIR COMPTA Work?
how_section.subtitle: A smooth, transparent, and collaborative 4-step workflow.

items.title: 1. Upload Documents
items.description: The client uploads invoices or receipts via web or mobile in PDF or photo format.

items.title: 2. AI Analysis & Extraction
items.description: OCR scans the document, extracts key data, and drafts the matching accounting entry.

items.title: 3. Accountant Verification
items.description: The certified accountant verifies the entry, approves it, and feeds the general journal.

items.title: 4. Reconciliation & Tax Ready
items.description: Bank statements are reconciled, and tax filing packages are ready on time without stress.

story.p1: Challenged by the complexity of tax compliance, the slowness of manual entry, and endless stacks of paper documents, we built a fintech platform tailored to the realities of the Algerian market.
